caption:
59.2 kilometres along the Guanacaste surf coast to the bay at Tamarindo.

Day 6 runs hotel to hotel out of Nosara. The route skirts Ostional, passes the fishing cove at San Juanillo, and rolls through Marbella, Playa Negra and Avellanas before bringing the bikes into town.

With 782 metres of climbing, it is a fast stage on dirt and gravel, with the hard climbing of the interior behind us. We sleep at Hotel Capitán Suizo at the south end of the beach.

We bring the route to this coast because a crossing of the Nicoya Peninsula should deliver you straight to the ocean.

Day 6 of The Gravel Expedition. Next departures 23 to 31 January 2027 and 3 to 11 July 2027. Details in the bio.
